functions.name: submit_material_request
functions.purpose: 销售提交申请，做必填、数量、重复明细校验，并推送市场审批提醒。
pseudo_code: lines = list material_request_line where request = request_id
for each line: assert request_qty > 0 and material.status = 启用
block or merge duplicate material lines
set request_status = 待审批 and submitted_at = now
send Feishu card to market group

functions.name: approve_material_request
functions.purpose: 市场审批通过或驳回申请。
pseudo_code: if action == reject: set request_status = 已驳回 and return
for each line: approved_qty = approved_qty || request_qty; assert approved_qty >= 0 and approved_qty <= request_qty
set request_status = 待发放 and approved_at = now

functions.name: batch_issue_request_lines
functions.purpose: 市场批量发放，库存不足拦截，防重复扣库存。
pseudo_code: line = get line with request and material
assert no existing ledger linked to this line
if material.current_stock < actual_issue_qty: mark line 缺货 and record failure
else: call apply_inventory_change(material, -actual_issue_qty, source_line=line_id, idempotency_key='issue:' + line_id)
set line_status = 已发放 or 部分发放
update parent request status by all line statuses

functions.name: apply_inventory_change
functions.purpose: 所有库存变更唯一入口。
pseudo_code: assert idempotency_key not exists in inventory_ledger
if ledger_type is outflow and after < 0: throw 库存不足
create inventory_ledger(before_stock=before, after_stock=after, quantity_delta=quantity_delta, ledger_status=有效)

functions.name: revert_inventory_ledger
functions.purpose: 撤回流水时新增反向流水，保留审计。
pseudo_code: call apply_inventory_change(material=ledger.material, ledger_type=撤回冲销, quantity_delta=reverse_delta, original_ledger=ledger_id)
